column4: My second question is around the progress on margins in France in the first half. [#512](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-512)

So France delivered good commercial dynamism across segments in the first half with revenue growth at plus 2.5%, of which plus 2% was organic. [#93](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-93)
Margin in France, so it's -- yes, it's not due to a lot of additional volume with operating leverage and so on. [#526](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-526)

Looking at geography, France represents now less than 30% of group revenue, illustrating how the rest of our footprint keeps gaining relative weight with a solid balance between mature regions such as Central Europe, U.K., Ireland, Scandinavia, Eastern Europe, and more dynamic regions such as Latin America, Southern Europe, which continue to offer strong structural growth potential. [#193](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-193)
Moving on to the next slide, let's take a look at revenue growth and EBITDA margin by geography. [#199](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-199)
Central Europe posted revenue growth of plus 5.9% in the first half, including plus 3.2% organic growth. [#100](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-100)

Revenue reached EUR 2,457.1 million in the first half, up 4.9%, including 3.2% organic growth with a similar pace of organic growth in Q2 at 3.2%. [#20](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-20)
Solid top line growth also generated some operating leverage helping margin progression. [#156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-156)
Revenue reached EUR 245.1 billion, up 4.9% year-on-year. [#211](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-211)

And I think that when you see the level of performance in this context., you can understand why we are quite relaxed even for '27 in France because we are so strong and we are exposed to so many, many end market type of customer. [#480](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-480)
